ios.desc:
Save time and stay focused—no more bouncing between translation apps, Google search and your notes. Study, practice, and reflect with dynamic language notes.

Why Duory?

• Duory is the smartest way to take language notes on your phone.
• Duory lets you keep and organize notes for all your target languages in one place.
• Save time and stay focused — no more bouncing between Google Search and your notes.
• Practice hands-free while doing boring chores.
• Improve your output by journaling in your target languages.
• Capture interesting phrases from anywhere!
• Browse vocabulary from your own notes in a focused, immersive way.
• Make them stick with Home and Lock Screen widgets.
• Duory supports 40 target languages.


NOTES

• Duory is designed to perform language tasks on-device thanks to Apple’s language APIs and other offline language tools.
• To perform translations, iOS needs to download language dictionaries for each language pair. This only happens once for each pair.
• Duory requires access to your microphone for you to record pronunciation of phrases and your camera for scanning text.


FREE FOREVER

Get started for free with these features:

• Create notes and journals in one target language.
• Enhance your language journals with Apple Journaling Suggestions.
• Capture phrases from your physical textbooks, Duolingo sessions, images, or RTF/PDF documents.  
• Use a handy widget to reinforce recently learned words and phrases. 
• In-app translation and transliteration, including Hiragana and Pinyin.
• Record and play back your phrases (no playlists on the free plan).
• Access notes you create during your free trial or subscription – forever!

Important: If you create notes in target languages outside of the initial language during an active subscription, they will become read-only when your subscription expires (the notes you create in your oldest target language will remain editable forever)


DUORY PLUS PLANS

Unlock the full power of Duory with a subscription:

• Create notes and journals in multiple languages.
• Turn your phrases into playlists for hands-free practice.
• Control playback from your lock screen or Control Center.
• Turn plain notes into memorable ones with stickers and pictures.
• Sync your notes and journals to iCloud.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Duory – A Notes App for Language Learners (iOS)

quotes.text:
Hey HN, I built Duory as a companion app for Duolingo users like myself. After years of using Apple Notes, I realized it wasn’t designed for language learners—so last July, I decided to build one.

Duory is a notes app with inline phrase support. You can translate, add romanization/kana, and even attach audio clips to phrases for playback.

Current features:

* In-app Translation – Add and translate phrases within notes
* Romanization – Convert non-Latin text (supports Japanese: Hiragana/Romaji)
* Audio & Playlists – Attach recordings, create playback loops, and control audio from the Lock Screen
* Repetition Mode – Customize playback order, loop phrases, and add pauses for practice
* Vocabulary Browser – View words extracted from your notes
* Journaling Mode – Special note type with target-language keyboard suggestions
* Quick Capture – Save phrases from Duolingo, images, or documents
* Widget Support – Recently added phrases at a glance

It's still early, but I’m actively working on bringing it to iPad and Mac this month (fingers crossed!).

(Heads-up: It’s freemium with a trial for premium features.)

I’d love your feedback—what features would you like to see next?

Thank you!
